text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I lost last time,
but I can't stay down about it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I hear that before a condor soars high,
it first swoops down in a steep dive..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That is why El, using her previous defeat as a springboard, shall soar up higggh into the skkkyyy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Trainer-san!
Make sure to hold on tight to El, okay?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
From here on, El will zoom forward
at supersonic speed!!
